value.conditions: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy (NACT) in early-stage TNBC
value.finding: Higher baseline gut microbiome alpha-diversity (Shannon index) is significantly associated with achieving pCR (Vernaci et al., 2023). Specific taxa like Bacteroides eggerthii were enriched in responders.

value.finding: High baseline Faith's phylogenetic diversity (PD) predicts prolonged progression-free survival (PFS), particularly in the atezolizumab arm (ALICE trial). Bifidobacterium enrichment was associated with lack of clinical benefit in this specific context.

value.conditions: Antimicrobial exposure during/after diagnosis
value.finding: Cumulative antimicrobial exposure is associated with decreased overall survival (OS) and breast cancer-specific survival (BCS), independent of stage and ANC. This effect persists for up to 3 years post-diagnosis.

value.conditions: Intratumoral Microbiota Load
value.finding: Higher intratumoral bacterial burden correlates with pCR to neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. High load is associated with increased FOLR2+ macrophages and decreased SPP1+ (immunosuppressive) macrophages.

value.conditions: Preclinical Models (Murine)
value.finding: Gut microbiota depletion (antibiotics/germ-free) attenuates doxorubicin efficacy and CD8+ T cell infiltration; fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) restores response. Engineered E. coli producing methioninase reduces tumor growth via methionine depletion. Microbial metabolite TMAO promotes anti-PD-1 efficacy via GSDME-mediated pyroptosis.

value.finding: 具有双向且依赖情境的免疫调节作用：一方面通过抑制HDAC活性、增强CD8+ T细胞毒性及TCR信号传导来增强抗肿瘤免疫；另一方面在某些情况下（如抗CTLA-4治疗中）可能抑制树突状细胞成熟，减弱T细胞激活。

value.conditions: 色氨酸代谢物
value.finding: 犬尿氨酸（Kyn）通过AhR通路促进Treg分化，抑制效应T细胞，削弱免疫反应；而吲哚-3-甲醛（I3A）和ICA则通过激活AhR/IL-22轴或抑制IDO1，增强CD8+ T细胞功能并维持肠道屏障完整性。

value.conditions: 胆汁酸（BAs）
value.finding: 次级胆汁酸如isoDCA促进Treg扩增，抑制DC功能；而UDCA通过降解TGF-β抑制Treg分化，增强抗肿瘤免疫。不同胆汁酸对CD8+ T细胞命运有截然相反的影响。

value.conditions: 肌苷（Inosine）
value.finding: 作为关键代谢物，肌苷通过抑制UBA6增加肿瘤免疫原性，结合A2AR促进Th1细胞分化，并在葡萄糖受限的微环境中作为替代能源维持效应T细胞的存活和杀伤功能。
